items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond was recordin' all of us... John Hammond just give that to me... the first blues show that ever was at Carnegie Hall, John Hammond gave it, an' I was on the show.

ctx.x: How long would...would they work there? Two or three weeks, or how long?
